changes.title: Browse every visible item in an open pile
changes.text: Examine a tile pile of two or more revealed items as a scrollable native item-icon and item-name list, in original top-first order and visible quantities, opening normal descriptions without pickup or identification.

changes.title: Read your run history turn by turn
changes.text: Open any recorded UIMSD run and browse actual event rows turn by turn, jumping one, ten, a hundred, a thousand or a custom amount. Empty/unrecorded turns never invent outcomes.

changes.title: Live collapsible damage effect information
changes.text: The active dungeon shows a small expandable HUD covering each current hero DoT and focused visible enemy: measured raw-input/HP/shield damage and live estimated future ticks with explicit uncertainty, retaining the original WndInfoBuff after opting out.

changes.title: Waterskin starts in the player's selected slot
changes.text: Player/test setting defaults to quickslot 2, remains adjustable across positions 1–6 and old Automatic/Off modes, persisted across app restarts. Existing runs swap without lost assignments when possible.

changes.title: Show Wandmaker wand upgrade levels
changes.text: Reveal just the offered wands' real upgrade levels before selection, with the regular ItemSlot visual, leaving otherwise unidentified items, curses and properties hidden.

changes.title: Blacksmith hammering stays at normal audio cadence
changes.text: Fast visual playback no longer retriggers the forge sound repeatedly at >1x; real-time SFX limiter with fractional-frame tolerance, no change to combat or visual playback.

changes.title: Core and native acceptance coverage
changes.text: Complete core suite passed source bcd775f5..., including newly added turn browsing, pile, audio cadence, Wandmaker levels, DoT forecast, and Waterskin tests. Native PileExaminationDeviceTest touches scrolled pile items. Full API34 check pending.

changes.title: Document private TEST285 against verified TEST284
changes.text: Keep release notes and permanent verified history without replacing prior APKs; request full private core/debug APK/native/visual verification. No tester distribution or actual physical phone claim.
